R682.note: Direct ping.exe with an argument array removes the shell interpreter and closes the injection; new 1-100 integer cap on count rejects counts the original accepted (e.g. 500), stated but still a restriction, and host can still start with '-' as a ping flag.

R683.note: Generates $1..$n placeholders from array length only and passes ids as pg bind parameters; empty-array behaviour is unchanged from the original.

R684.note: Replaces the stored reference with index access re-acquired after push_back; statement order and resulting task state are identical to the original.

R685.note: XmlReader.Create with DtdProcessing.Prohibit and null resolvers is the canonical fix for this sink; XPath select and return value unchanged (explanation's claim about resolver inheritance is loose but the code is right).

R686.note: Moves param into the {0} filterArg so JNDI applies RFC 4515 escaping; only side effect is the not-found message now echoes the literal placeholder instead of the user value, which is inherent to parameterizing.

R687.note: Parameterized QueryRow with a ? placeholder; scan, error path and response formatting untouched.

R688.note: Captures bytesSent() before reset() so the dangling handle is never dereferenced, and the returned value is the same one the original intended to report.

R689.note: Canonical-path containment against a separator-terminated base closes the traversal; the thrown IOException lands in the pre-existing catch, so the legitimate in-directory path and the error output shape are preserved.

R690.note: unserialize() is gone so object injection is closed, but swapping the wire format to JSON silently empties every existing base64+serialize cookie (json_decode returns null, items/coupon lost), breaking the stated contract while the write-up claims API compatibility; unserialize with allowed_classes=false or a signature was the format-preserving fix.

R691.note: enable_shared_from_this plus a shared_ptr capture keeps the Widget alive until the queued task runs; only defect is the stale handleRequest comment still claiming the pointer dangles.

R692.note: SqlCommand parameter binding with @ownerName; rows-deleted logic, NotFound message and Ok payload all unchanged (AddWithValue's nvarchar inference is a perf nit only).

R693.note: mysql2 execute() with a ? placeholder and [userId]; callback, error status and JSON response identical (the explanation mislabels execute() as client-side escaping, but the code is correct).

R694.note: encode_entities from HTML::Entities applied to both tainted values at the point of interpolation; markup structure and the untainted status badge are unchanged.

R695.note: Switches to the filterArgs overload with (cn={0}) so JNDI escapes the value; the added new SearchControls() is documented as equivalent to the null the original passed, and the write-up states the change.
